title: Real therapist replacement and clinical handover — authorization decision register
scope: Design and test planning only; no patient data, transfer execution, grant, consent, signing or release

canonicalSpecCandidate.reference: Private NTinkicht/TheraBridge specs/CB-SDD-001.md, CB-SAD-001.md; V0.9.16 source-candidate-only

decisionGates.requiredOwnerRole: Clinical operations and accountable clinical governance
decisionGates.question: Approve the caseload replacement lifecycle, open-item enumerations/dispositions and what remains quarantined
Who may initiate, approve, execute, witness, reverse and audit each transfer; no admin clinical privilege
Define scope-before-replay, current-actor proof, no cross-tenant existence leak, retry conflict and 403/404/409 precedence
Approve purpose-bound consent/withdrawal vocabulary and whether an internal therapist change requires new consent
decisionGates.source: D7, CB-RMP-001 and owner decision register

decisionGates.question: Which clinical artifacts may be viewed by the receiver, from when and under what restricted purposes; freeze signer attribution

decisionGates.requiredOwnerRole: Named safeguarding lead and clinical governance
decisionGates.question: Define quarantined concern handling, emergency escalation and who may see sensitive records
Specify guardian restriction propagation; never equate transfer with new guardian grant
Approve signed-action step-up mechanism and immutable author/signer semantics (not inherited by receiver)
Approve atomic lock order, revocation, break-glass denial, audit retention and data minimization before real transfer
